summary: Phase 2 Event Center (public ticketing) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest: 7/7 passed — /config/paypal returns enabled:false; public events list contains free-community-meetup; event detail returns Free RSVP $0 ticket + T-shirt select custom field; FREE register creates 2 unique attendees with EVT-XXXXXXXX-XXXX codes, order completed, ticket_types.sold incremented by 2, ticket lookup returns attendee+event+venue and base64 PNG QR data URI; paid path returns HTTP 503 with 'not available'/'not configured' message; admin POST /api/events/attendees/{id}/resend returns success (SMTP wrapped in try/except); GET /api/events/verify/{code} resolves real ticket. Frontend (Playwright) E2E: /events renders events-public-page grid with public-event-free-community-meetup card, EVENTS nav link exists in header DOM (events_enabled=true), event-detail-page loads with ticket-selector + registration-form, qty-plus-* increments, buyer-name/email inputs work, custom-field-* T-shirt select works (S/M/L), cart-total shows 'Free', register-submit-btn labeled 'Get Tickets', click navigates to /events/confirmation?order=... showing confirmation-success with view-ticket-* link, clicking View Ticket renders ticket-render with ticket-qr (data:image/png;base64,...), event title 'FREE COMMUNITY MEETUP', attendee 'TEST_E2E_Buyer', ticket code 'EVT-28C992CF-DF7F' and Status: valid. Admin /admin/events/attendees loads event-attendees-page with door-verify-box; scan-toggle-btn toggles without crashing and shows a graceful 'Camera error — Could not start camera. Use manual entry.' toast in headless (acceptable); manual verify-code-input + verify-btn renders verify-result with 'Allow & Check In' verify-checkin-btn; clicking it sets status to checked_in (confirmed via API, checked_in_at populated) and re-verify shows 'Already Checked In'.

issues: Venue displays '--' on the concert-style ticket when event has no venue_id (Free Community Meetup has none). Acceptable, but consider hiding the VENUE column when null.

The 'Preview Mode' (123 Bots Preview, password 8487) gate is currently shown on /login despite /app/memory/test_credentials.md stating it is disabled. Bypassable with 8487, but credentials file should be updated.

action_items: Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md: site preview password (8487) appears active again on /login — either disable it or note it as enabled for testing agents.
Optional: hide the VENUE label on the rendered ticket (/events/ticket/{code}) when event has no venue assigned (currently shows '--').

Optional: the public events list page (/events) renders the events grid only after dismissing the 'Welcome to 123Bots!' industry modal — modal is properly dismissible and not blocking interactions, but consider deferring it on the public events route.
critical_code_review_comments: event_center.py public_register: when total <= 0, ticket_types.$.sold is incremented inside _issue_tickets_and_email — verified working. Same incrementor relies on ticket_type_id being present in line_items; OK because we build from server-side tt_map.
public_register paid path correctly returns 503 with two distinct messages ('Online payment is not available' vs 'PayPal checkout is not configured for online purchase') — good UX.
_make_qr_data_uri returns a base64 PNG data URI; works in browser ✓ (verified visually).
Admin /api/events/attendees endpoint returns a plain list (not a paginated dict) — works fine, but page assumes list.filter; not currently broken since UI iterates with .map.

GET /api/public/events/ticket/{ticket_code} exposes the full attendee document including email/phone via a public URL knowing only the ticket_code. Consider whether to omit email/phone from the public response (current behavior leaks PII to anyone with the code from a shared image).
